explanation: For each transaction count, keep the best cash balance while holding a share and after selling. Update counts downward so each transition uses the previous day’s lower-count state. When k cannot bind, sum all positive adjacent gains.
spaceComplexity: O(k), or O(1) in the unlimited-transactions case
